Subject: Post-call: SOC2 status + data deletion / log retention next steps

Hi Emma / Bryan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on security/compliance items you raised: 

Summary from call
- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II (in-scope: Security, Availability). We run annual audits; the latest report (2025) is summarized below and I attached the full summary.
- Data retention & deletion: Default application logs are retained 90 days; customer-configurable retention for embeddings/outputs accessible via Console/Policy API. Backups are encrypted and retained for 180 days by default; we support custom retention windows for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Log retention/forensics: Audit logs (control plane) stored 365 days; requestable exports for incident forensics.

Requests / next steps
1) I’ll share a short retention summary and SOC 2 one-pager (attached).
2) Emma / Bryan: please send your Vendor Security Questionnaire (or the specific fields you want us to fill). If you prefer, we can complete the attached XLS and return it by EOD Friday.
3) Neha / Ben (cc’d): can you confirm the current options and exact API key-level deletion semantics we discussed so Emma can confirm with privacy/legal? Specifically: permanent deletion vs. soft-delete window and whether KV cache snapshots are covered by same policy.

If helpful, I’m available for a 30-minute follow-up to walk the security team through our retention controls and SOC 2 scope. What time works for you next week?

Thanks,
Dylan
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Post-call: SOC2 status + data deletion / log retention next steps

Dylan / Ben —

Quick answers for the questionnaire items Emma called out (I’ll add short lines to the XLS):
- Backups: default 180 days; for Dedicated customers we can configure down to 30 days through the ops console. For Hosted API customers we provide a managed-config option; for enterprise we can set a delegated retention policy (ops ticket required).
- Deletion semantics: we have a two-stage flow — soft-delete marker applied immediately; background worker purges persistent storage and derivative embeddings within the configured purge window. For Hosted customers the standard purge window is 30 days after a deletion request, for Dedicated/Private we can meet 7-day or immediate purge SLAs depending on contract. I’ll cite the API endpoints and RFC IDs in the questionnaire.
- Encryption / tamper-resistance: backups are AES-256 at rest, KMS-managed keys with rotation; audit logs are write-once append-only with HMAC signing for tamper evidence. SOC 2 summary focuses on control tests for log integrity — I’ll attach the relevant control IDs.

Ben — can you confirm the exact API names and include the mutation docs (DELETE /v1/data/records, POST /v1/retention/policy) and whether we have a signed SLA for 7-day purge in any existing contracts?

-Neha
Sr. Product Security Engineer
